mutation_revert: Apply each mutation alone on top of the commit's own tree; run the named test -count=1 -v (-race where stated); require --- FAIL with the stated reason; git checkout -- <file>; require git diff --quiet before the next. A mutation that does not red is a finding to report, never a mutation to change silently.
